settings.heading: VERSATILITY BUILT IN
settings.text: Switch between three hitch ball sizes to handle different trailers, while the integrated tow hook and rotating D-ring shackle add even more towing and recovery options. Designed for 2-1/2" receivers, this versatile hitch helps keep you ready for changing jobs, trailers, and towing needs.

settings.heading: ADJUST FOR THE RIGHT TOWING HEIGHT
settings.text: The adjustable design makes it easy to match your hitch height to different trailers for a more level towing setup. A secure receiver connection helps reduce unnecessary movement, giving you a solid, dependable setup whether you're heading to the jobsite or hitting the road.

settings.heading: THREE BALL SIZES. MORE TRAILER OPTIONS
settings.text: From light-duty utility trailers to larger campers and equipment trailers, three integrated ball sizes give you the flexibility to tow more without constantly changing ball mounts.

settings.heading: BUILT FOR WORK. READY FOR ADVENTURE
settings.text: One hitch, more ways to get things moving. Use it with utility trailers, boats, campers, equipment trailers, and more. Its versatile configuration makes it a practical choice for everyday hauling during the week and recreational towing when the weekend arrives.
